DESIGN SPEC:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied image, which is ONLY this maker's inspected initial poster. Produce exactly ONE independent single flat opaque portrait poster, width:height 2:3.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

Observed repair cause: At the diagonal connection the blue and orange tooth tips merely meet; the blue tooth does not enter the orange valley. Make the gearing physically credible. The symmetric arc ends also leave opposite rotations unclear.

Primary change: Repair the shared mesh in the center-right area. Preserve the unequal wheel sizes and overall diagonal center arrangement. Bring the smaller wheel slightly down-left toward the large wheel by about half a tooth height, and change its tooth phase by approximately half a tooth spacing. Rebuild the two local tooth profiles as needed so the blue teeth occupy the empty valleys between orange teeth and orange teeth occupy the valleys between blue teeth. Show two to three alternating tooth-and-valley engagements with narrow consistent clearance. Their tooth pitch and thickness must match at the pitch circles; use compatible radial spur-gear teeth with sensible taper. A tooth flank touches the opposing flank at the working contact. No tip-to-tip touching, no tooth tips overlaid on each other, no one wheel on top of the other. Both wheel bodies stay in the same plane. Keep that working contact fully visible and clear of type.

Supporting change: Preserve one broad pale swept paper sector per wheel. Keep the small-wheel sector visibly about twice the angular sweep of the large-wheel sector. Give each sector a subtle broad-to-narrow paper-sweep progression in opposite senses, without arrowheads or drawn arrows: the blue wheel's sweep develops clockwise, the orange wheel's sweep develops counterclockwise. It remains a broad inset shape, not a symbol, annotation, ruler or measurement. The sectors must remain clearly distinct from Hangul.

Maintain the current matte cut-paper genre, cobalt blue large wheel lower-left, vermilion orange smaller wheel upper-right, pale warm-gray background, plain round hubs, restrained consistent down-right shadows, deliberate large-wheel edge crop, substantial nonglyph relation and clean silhouettes. Preserve the title's readable firm unwarped Hangul, natural syllable proportions, open counters and dark color as a single compact three-line block in the left shared wedge beside the mechanism. Keep only the original words in their original order and word boundaries, each whole word on one line; do not duplicate them. Protect open space between the final title line and blue teeth; if the corrected small wheel needs room, make only a slight local adjustment while keeping the title a counterweight adjacent to the mesh, not a separate header.

No other text, characters, labels, numbers, ticks, logos, watermarks, ornamental marks, panels, contact sheet, border or mockup. No added objects. Preserve 2:3 portrait and opaque background. The gear connection, not the paper surface effect, carries the meaning.
